title: Event Horizon (Interstellar-style, original)
description: Original piece in the style of a space-film organ score: a ticking clock, a swelling pipe-organ drone, an A-minor eighth-note ostinato (i–VI–iv–V), then pads, bass and a slow melody. Time unit = 1 beat.

voices.name: tick
voices.comment: Clock tick on every beat, accented each bar.

voices.name: drone
voices.comment: Low A pipe-organ pedal. Detune makes it beat slowly.

voices.name: arp
voices.comment: Original ostinato: Am | F | Dm | E, eighth notes.
voices.seq: A3 E4 A4 C5 B4 C5 A4 E4 | F3 C4 F4 A4 G4 A4 F4 C4 | D3 A3 D4 F4 E4 F4 D4 A3 | E3 B3 E4 G#4 F#4 G#4 E4 B3

voices.name: pad
voices.comment: Whole-note organ chords, voice-led around A3.

voices.name: melody
voices.comment: Original 8-bar line; offset 48 so it starts at the top of 'gravity'.
